rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of lo-ting, Dark-faced short-yellow-haired fish-person plunging into the sea. Create one square PNG at least 1024 by 1024.
ANATOMY: One MATURE ADULT human-height fish-person, never childlike with a dark humanlike face, very short cropped yellowish hair, only 2 cm long, two eyes, two arms and two legs, and a tiny blunt cylindrical one-cun (3 cm) tail, absolutely no fins on this tail at the lower back. Fully opaque plain dark linen torso and hip covering, legs visible; wet fishlike skin, normal round human ears, absolutely no pointed ears, no huge mermaid tail and no fins anywhere. [lo-ting-c01, lo-ting-c09]
MOMENT: Plunge forcefully from an oyster-shell island wall into dark seawater toward the foreground, twisting so the tiny tail is clearly visible; mature adult weathered face and small focused intense eyes face the viewer, splashing landing.
POWER: Forceful plunge into water when encountering people, a real close-up splash. No supernatural attack. [lo-ting-c09]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, confrontational close framing; subject fills 80 percent of the image, unmistakable silhouette at 200 pixels. Strictly human-sized; dominance only from close perspective, no tiny boats or giant scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low-key warm moonlight or dusk source as appropriate, sharp rim light, deep walnut shadows, sparse contextual spray or dust; dark warm painterly palette with antique gold accent, no flat daylight.
SURFACE: tactile weathered natural materials, detailed rough skin, wet scales or coarse hair where anatomically appropriate; thick expressive oil brushwork and premium cinematic composition.
SETTING: Island seashore around Dayushan, Hong Kong, with an oyster-shell wall. [lo-ting-c04, lo-ting-c06, lo-ting-c09]
MOOD: Overwhelming uncanny awe through unfamiliar ancient fish-person anatomy; startled harmless being, never evil; overwhelming and imposing, never cute, calm, decorative or static. No modern costume.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, no lettering, no symbols, no glyphs or pseudo-glyphs, no inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs, fingers or eyes; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Background subordinate to subject.
